_about: Media & Output: two tabs. Abilities draws the project switches above the list and, inside each ability, its switch, its service and the inventory rows that are its defaults (the manager's own copies of quality, voice, format, retention and folders are gone). Pictures & files holds what the assistant takes in and where results go.
